description: CSS-only, data-driven tooltip system requiring zero JavaScript.
html_snippet:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/axis-twelve@2.0.2/dist/modules/axis-tooltips.min.css">
    <title>Axis Tooltips Example</title>
</head>
<body>
    <button data-ax-tooltip="Hello World!">Tooltipped Button</button>
</body>
</html>

attributes.name: data-ax-tooltip
attributes.description: The text content of the tooltip.

notes: Does not work on void elements (input, img) without a wrapper.
Positions are logical and adapt to RTL automatically.
accessibility: Ensure description is also in aria-label if needed

evolution.description: Switched to Logical Positioning with physical fallbacks.
